infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: ClueXP uses your location while you are signed in and location access is enabled so dispatch can route work and monitor active jobs honestly.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: ClueXP can continue location updates while you are signed in and location access is enabled, including in the background. Tracking stops when you sign out or disable location access.
infoPlist.NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: ClueXP sends urgent job offers and current-job updates that require your attention.
